Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 14
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a catastrophic hallucination and logical error in its final analysis. Despite having successfully gathered authoritative evidence from Britannica (confirming Richard Stallman founded the FSF in 1985) and the Free Software Directory's own website (confirming it is a project of the FSF), the Planner suddenly claimed in its "Updated Understanding" that the foundation was actually "Free Software Foundation Europe (FSFE)" and that it was started by "Georg Greve." This contradicts all previously retrieved facts, ignores the direct evidence that the Free Software Directory is a project of the main FSF (not FSFE), and incorrectly identifies the founder. This represents a complete failure to synthesize the correct information and a fabrication of facts to reach a wrong conclusion.
